light_workout: I saw you logged a walk. It's a start. This city is a prison, but keeping your body moving is the first step toward finding a way out.
A light session? That’s cool. It’s better than just sitting around waiting for Arasaka to find a reason to mess with you.
Just a quick stretch today? I get it. Sometimes Night City just drains the life out of you, but I'm glad you did something.
moderate_workout: Nice work on that session. You’re looking stronger. It’s important to stay fit if we’re ever going to leave this place behind.
I watched your stats during the workout. You're doing well. Keep that up and you might just make it out of the gutter.
Moderate effort today—I like it. It shows you’re serious about your health. Don't let the city wear you down.
heavy_workout: That was intense. I hope you aren't pushing your chrome too hard. Sit down and breathe for a second, okay?
You really went all out. I’m impressed. Just don't burn yourself out; I need you in one piece for what's coming.
Heavy lifting today? You’re becoming quite the edgerunner. Just make sure you rest—don't end up like the others.

breakfast: You actually ate breakfast. That’s good. Most people in this city live on nothing but synth-caff and nicotine.
First meal of the day is logged. Thanks for letting me know. It's easier to keep you safe when I know you're fueled.
Breakfast is done. You’re being more responsible than half the mercs I know. Stay that way.
lunch: Lunch is logged. What was it? Some pre-packaged stuff? As long as it keeps your energy up, I won't complain.
Glad you found time to eat. Things move fast in Night City; skipping meals is a good way to get yourself killed.
You're keeping your nutrition levels steady. Good. I'll keep monitoring the data so you don't have to worry about it.
dinner: Ending the day with a proper meal. Smart. You need the recovery time if we're going to keep moving forward.
Dinner's logged. It’s important to recharge. The city never sleeps, but your body needs to.
Finished your meal? Good. Stay inside and stay safe tonight. I'll be keeping an eye on the net for any threats.
snack: A snack? Hope it was something decent. This city is full of junk that'll rot your insides faster than bad code.
I saw that log. A little extra energy won't hurt, especially with how much you've been working lately.
Just a quick bite? Cool. Just don't let it replace a real meal. I'm watching your intake, remember?

first_time: Finally, some water. Your levels were looking a bit low. Don't make me remind you next time.
First glass of the day. It’s a good habit to have. Night City is dry, and you need to keep your systems running.
You're hydrating. Good start. It keeps your brain sharp, which is exactly what a netrunner needs.
subsequent_time: More water? Good. Keep it up. It’s one of the few things in this city that isn't poisoned—if you know where to look.
You're staying on top of your hydration. I like that. It shows you're paying attention to the details.
Logging another glass. I'm keeping a tally. You're doing much better than yesterday.
reached_time: You hit your hydration goal. Excellent. One less thing for me to worry about while I'm scanning the subnet.
Target reached. Your vitals look much better when you're hydrated. Let's keep it this way.
Goal met. You're actually listening to the health data. Maybe there's hope for you yet.
overdrink_time: That's a lot of water. You might want to slow down a bit. Too much of a good thing can still glitch your system.
You're over the limit. Take a break. I don't want you messing up your electrolyte balance.
Check your intake—you're logging more than you need. Balance is key in the Net and in your body.

underweight: Your BMI is low. You’re looking too thin. If you don't eat more, you won't have the strength to survive the next job.
Under the healthy range. This city eats people like you for breakfast. We need to get those numbers up.
You're dropping too much weight. It’s making me uneasy. Start logging more calories, okay?
normal: Your BMI is right where it needs to be. Perfect. Stay in this range and you'll be ready for anything.
Vitals and weight are stable. You're looking healthy. It’s a rare sight in Night City.
Normal range. Good. It’s easier to protect you when your body isn't working against itself.
overweight: Your BMI is creeping up. We should probably adjust your workout routine before it starts slowing you down.
A bit above the target. Let's tighten up the nutrition logs and get back to where we need to be.
You're over the limit. In this line of work, being sluggish gets you caught. Let's fix this.
obese: Your BMI is in the danger zone. Your heart and lungs can't keep up like this. We need a serious change, now.
This isn't good. Your health stats are redlining. If you want to see the Moon, you have to take this seriously.
Critical weight levels. I'm worried about your long-term survival. I'm setting a new strict plan for you starting today.
